audience: staffing agencies and recruiters that run their pipeline in Ceipal

useCases.title: Review the applicants for a job
useCases.text: List the job postings, open one and read the applicants and submissions that match it.

useCases.title: Prepare for an interview
useCases.text: Read an applicant and the interviews that are set for that person.

useCases.title: Check the talent bench
useCases.text: List the consultants on the bench and open one to read the details.

useCases.title: Review a client account
useCases.text: Read a client with the notes and the contacts. Then list the open requisitions.

useCases.title: Track placements and vendors
useCases.text: List the placements and the vendors to see who works where.
